```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

#-------------------------------------------
# Function: Train RF on train + validation
#-------------------------------------------
train_rf_cumulative <- function(train_file, valid_file, lags_to_include, seed=123) {
  
  # Load data
  train_data <- read.csv(train_file)
  valid_data <- read.csv(valid_file)
  
  target_col <- "status_label_1yr"
  all_features <- names(train_data)
  
  # Base year variables
  base_vars <- all_features[str_detect(all_features, "^X[0-9]+$")]
  predictor_cols <- base_vars
  
  # Add lag variables
  if (length(lags_to_include) > 0) {
    for (lag in lags_to_include) {
      lag_pattern <- paste0("_", lag, "yr$")
      lag_vars <- all_features[str_detect(all_features, lag_pattern)]
      predictor_cols <- c(predictor_cols, lag_vars)
    }
  }
  
  message("Training model with ", length(predictor_cols), 
          " predictors | Lags: ", paste(lags_to_include, collapse=", "))
  
  selected_cols <- c(target_col, predictor_cols)
  train_data <- train_data %>% select(any_of(selected_cols))
  valid_data <- valid_data %>% select(any_of(selected_cols))
  
  train_data[[target_col]] <- as.factor(train_data[[target_col]])
  valid_data[[target_col]] <- as.factor(valid_data[[target_col]])
  
  train_data[[target_col]] <- droplevels(train_data[[target_col]])
  valid_data[[target_col]] <- droplevels(valid_data[[target_col]])
  
  set.seed(seed)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
    data = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_data)-1),
    importance = TRUE,
    strata = train_data[[target_col]],
    sampsize = rep(min(table(train_data[[target_col]])), 2)
  )
  
  # Validation predictions
  prob_valid <- predict(rf_model, valid_data, type="prob")[,2]
  roc_obj <- roc(valid_data[[target_col]], prob_valid)
  auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)
  
  return(list(
    model=rf_model,
    roc=roc_obj,
    auc=auc_value,
    predictors=predictor_cols
  ))
}

#-------------------------------------------
# Step 1: Train all candidates on VAL set
#-------------------------------------------

val_train <- "../data/Val_traindata/df_train_val.csv"
val_valid <- "../data/Val_traindata/df_test_val.csv"

rf_base <- train_rf_cumulative(val_train, val_valid, lags_to_include=c())
rf_lag1 <- train_rf_cumulative(val_train, val_valid, lags_to_include=c(1))
rf_lag2 <- train_rf_cumulative(val_train, val_valid, lags_to_include=c(1,2))
rf_lag3 <- train_rf_cumulative(val_train, val_valid, lags_to_include=c(1,2,3))



#-------------------------------------------
# Step 2: Compare validation AUCs
#-------------------------------------------
auc_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Base", "Base+Lag1", "Base+Lag2", "Base+Lag3"),
  Lags = c("0", "1", "1,2", "1,2,3"),
  AUC = c(rf_base$auc, rf_lag1$auc, rf_lag2$auc, rf_lag3$auc)
)

print(auc_df)

best_index <- which.max(auc_df$AUC)
best_model_name <- auc_df$Model[best_index]

#-------------------------------------------
# CONFUSION MATRIX FOR BEST VALIDATION MODEL
#-------------------------------------------

valid_df <- read.csv(val_valid)
true_valid <- as.factor(valid_df$status_label_1yr)

# Helper to get predicted classes
get_cm <- function(model, data, true_labels) {
  preds <- predict(model$model, data, type = "response")
  table(Predicted = preds, Actual = true_labels)
}

# Select the correct model object
best_model_obj <- switch(
  best_model_name,
  "Base" = rf_base,
  "Base+Lag1" = rf_lag1,
  "Base+Lag2" = rf_lag2,
  "Base+Lag3" = rf_lag3
)

cat("\n✅ Confusion Matrix for BEST model (on VALIDATION set):\n")
print(get_cm(best_model_obj, valid_df, true_valid))


cat("\n✅ Best model based on validation AUC:", best_model_name, "\n")

# Extract best lag combination
best_lags <- switch(
  best_model_name,
  "Base" = c(),
  "Base+Lag1" = c(1),
  "Base+Lag2" = c(1,2),
  "Base+Lag3" = c(1,2,3)
)

cat("✅ Selected lag features:", paste(best_lags, collapse=", "), "\n")

#-------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Plot all validation ROC curves
#-------------------------------------------
plot(rf_base$roc, col="#1b9e77", lwd=2, main="Validation ROC Curves")
lines(rf_lag1$roc, col="#d95f02", lwd=2)
lines(rf_lag2$roc, col="#7570b3", lwd=2)
lines(rf_lag3$roc, col="#e7298a", lwd=2)
abline(a=0, b=1, lty=2, col="gray")

legend("bottomright",
       legend=paste(c("Base", "Lag1", "Lag1+2", "Lag1+2+3"),
                    "AUC=", round(c(rf_base$auc, rf_lag1$auc, rf_lag2$auc, rf_lag3$auc), 3)),
       col=c("#1b9e77","#d95f02","#7570b3","#e7298a"),
       lwd=2, bty="n")

#-------------------------------------------
# Step 4: Retrain winner on FULL training set
#-------------------------------------------

final_train <- "../data/Final_traindata/df_train_full.csv"
final_test  <- "../data/Final_traindata/df_test.csv"

rf_final <- train_rf_cumulative(
  train_file = final_train,
  valid_file = final_test,
  lags_to_include = best_lags
)

cat("\n✅ FINAL MODEL AUC on FINAL TEST SET =", round(rf_final$auc, 3), "\n")



#-------------------------------------------
# Step 5: Plot FINAL ROC
#-------------------------------------------
plot(rf_final$roc, col="#1b9e77", lwd=3,
     main=paste("Final Test ROC Curve (", best_model_name, ")", sep=""))

abline(a=0, b=1, lty=2, col="gray")

# Add AUC text to the plot
text(
  x = 0.6, y = 0.1,
  labels = paste("AUC =", round(rf_final$auc, 3)),
  cex = 1.2
)

```
